name: LaForge fan skins
description: Unofficial fan skins: a Pokémon trainer handheld, an Avengers command room and the DC Watchtower. Not affiliated with the rights holders.

skins.name: pokemon-trainer
skins.label: Trainer HUD
skins.description: An unofficial fan skin in the manner of a Pokémon trainer's handheld: a red capsule rail, your crew as a party with HP bars, battle text boxes for panes. Not affiliated with the rights holders.

skins.name: avengers-mission-control
skins.label: Mission Control (Avengers)
skins.description: An unofficial fan skin in the manner of the Avengers' command room: brushed gunmetal, red and gold armour plating, mission-briefing pane headers and a pulsing team alert. Not affiliated with the rights holders.

skins.name: dc-watchtower
skins.label: Watchtower (DC)
skins.description: An unofficial fan skin in the manner of the Justice League's Watchtower: an orbital station over the planet, deep-space navy with a Metropolis-blue rail, a noir signal in the sky for whoever needs you, and distress beacons on blocked seats. Not affiliated with the rights holders.
